definition: A machine learning approach that combines predictions from multiple models to produce a more accurate and robust result than any single model.
details: Ensemble methods (including bagging, boosting, and stacking) exploit the fact that different models often make different errors, so combining them can cancel out individual weaknesses.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. Think of it this way: A machine learning approach that combines predictions from multiple models to produce a more accurate and robust result than any single model. And here is the clever part: Ensemble methods (including bagging, boosting, and stacking) exploit the fact that different models often make different errors, so combining them can cancel out individual weaknesses. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Ensemble Learning — a small key that opens a big door.
